answer.text: Yes. Southern Cross Builders Pty Ltd paid in about 26–28 days through to Q4 2024, within the 30-day terms. Since then the average has climbed every quarter, to 36.1 days in Q1 2025, 55.3 in Q4 2025 and 76.6 in Q3 2026. That is well over double the terms.
assumptions: Customer matched to 'Southern Cross Builders Pty Ltd'.
Quarterly grain over all available history; covers paid invoices only.
Q4 2026 (from 2026-10-01) has no paid invoices yet, so no value.

sql.sql:
select date_trunc('quarter', i.invoice_date)::date as period, round(avg(i.days_to_pay), 1) as avg_days_to_pay
from marts.fct_invoices as i
inner join marts.dim_customer as c on c.customer_key = i.customer_key
where c.customer_name = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 1
limit %(row_limit)s

select c.customer_name as customer, round(avg(i.days_to_pay), 1) as avg_days_to_pay
from marts.fct_invoices as i
inner join marts.dim_customer as c on c.customer_key = i.customer_key
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s

from marts.fct_invoices as i

where c.customer_name = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 1
limit %(row_limit)s
